## Reflection

The high-dose wells carried the call: nuc_major_axis z=+10.3 at 30 uM with nuc_dna_mean z=-6.1, monotonic rho=+1.00 for elongation and rho=-1.00 for dimmer mean DNA but flat integrated DNA (e13 rho=+0.10), plus flat tub_mean (e16) and flat frac_mitotic_like (e11), pointed to chromatin decondensation with growth without division rather than replication block or mitotic arrest. What was wrong or missed:
- Final probabilities 0.50 and 0.45 overstated certainty when atlas majority was DNA damage 5/10 and microscopist call was unknown in e5.
- Lowest-dose well e18 (0.01 uM) with nuc_dna_mean z=-2.9 was mis-used to increase kinase confidence despite adding no dose discrimination.
- Acquisition order was inefficient: compare_to_reference_atlas in e6 was done before 3 uM (e8) and 0.1 uM (e7) wells existed, and all acquisitions were rep 1 with no replication, prompting the requested re-run in e21.

Proposed next experiment: Dose PD-169316 with direct p38 target-engagement readout (phospho-MK2/HSP27) plus cell-cycle flow, p21 and gamma-H2AX immunofluorescence to confirm p38 inhibition with cytostatic arrest and rule out DNA-damage response.
